summary: The Royal Thai Army spokesperson, Major General Winthai Suwaree, firmly refuted claims made by Cambodian counterpart Mali Sojiata regarding alleged tank deployments near observation lines, territorial occupation of Ban Chok Chey, and civilian displacements, clarifying that Thailand's actions strictly follow sovereign law, bilateral agreements, and GBC frameworks.
title: Army Spokesperson Refutes Mali Sojiata Claims as Entirely Inaccurate
